abilities.effect: The triggering creature falls into the pit but can attempt a DC 18 Reflex save to Grab an Edge to avoid falling. On a failure, a creature falls 20 feet into an eye-filled pit. The eyes cushion the fall so the 20-foot fall inflicts only 5 bludgeoning damage, but they also completely obscure vision; a character is effectively blind as long as they remain in the pit. The walls of the pit are slick, though a character can Climb them with a successful DC 25 Athletics check.
abilities.name: Pitfall
abilities.trigger: A creature walks into a large pit's square

abilities.effect: The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex save or fall prone (on a critical failure, the creature also twists its ankle and becomes clumsy 1 until it receives any amount of healing).
abilities.name: Trip
abilities.trigger: A creature walks into a small pit's square

hazard.description: A layer of disembodied eyes obscures a pitfall in the floor that's either deep enough for a human to fall into, or narrow enough to cause a painful fall.
hazard.disable: This hazard can't be disabled, merely avoided.
hazard.name: Obscured Pitfalls

link.alt: Crown of the Kobold King pg. 79
link.name: Crown of the Kobold King pg. 79

hazard.stealth: DC 18 (or 0 if the eyes covering an area that obscures a pitfall are destroyed)

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
